summary:
Verification of 'Multiplicative Chow-Künneth decomposition and homology splitting of configuration spaces' by Dan Petersen and Orsola Tommasi completed in exhaustive mode with lenient strictness. The paper was segmented into 30 snippets (14 sections, 8 equations, 3 tables, 1 figure, 2 proofs, 1 proposition, 1 theorem).

The multiplicative condition on the small diagonal and the projector definitions follow standard conventions in the literature.

VISION VERIFICATION (1 figure, 3 tables): No errors detected. The one embedded figure (a commutative diagram relating categories of motives and mixed Hodge structures) is consistent with the surrounding text. Tables 2-4 (cohomology of M_{2,n} and H_{∞,n}) are internally consistent and follow the patterns described in the text.

No fabricated citations or attribution mismatches detected.

CROSS-SECTION CONSISTENCY: The paper's sections are logically connected. Section 2 establishes the theoretical framework (multiplicative decomposition → cohomology splitting), Section 3 applies it to compute local system cohomology on M_2, and Section 4 presents computational results for M_{2,n} and H_{∞,n}. No contradictions between sections were found.

OVERALL: The paper passes verification. The single finding (incomplete sentence in 3.12) is a presentation issue with low confidence (0.45) and does not affect the mathematical correctness of the paper. Under lenient strictness, this does not warrant an error flag.
